results.description:
SA Marine Mortality Events 2025 – 2026.
Area observed starting from breakwall at north end of Glenelg beach to pedestrian ramp 50m south of Pier Street.  Then between Somerton SLSC ramp and ramp at south end about 600m away.
Mortalities: No obvious very recent mortalities other than possibly crabs or shellfish. Various shellfish, occasional crab remnants, rarely sponges.
Foam observed in varying amounts at Glenelg from Kent Street storm drain northward about 800m. Some localised smaller patches of foam in fairly minor amounts in other areas.
Beach wrack generally in minor amounts in most areas with some areas of greater amounts, widespread seagrass wrack at north end of Glenelg.
Some light rain overnight in places, cool/mild condition. Wind from S-SSW around 10 knots. Water dirty close to shore in northern areas.

results.description:
SA Marine Mortality Events 2025 – 2026.
Area observed starting from breakwall at north end of Glenelg beach to pedestrian ramp 50m south of Pier Street.  Then between Somerton SLSC ramp and ramp at south end about 600m away.
Mortalities: No obvious very recent mortalities other than possibly crabs or shellfish. Various shellfish, occasional crab remnants, rarely sponges.
Foam observed in varying amounts at Glenelg from Kent Street storm drain northward about 800m. Some localised smaller patches of foam in fairly minor amounts in other areas.
Beach wrack generally in minor amounts in most areas with some areas of greater amounts, widespread seagrass wrack at north end of Glenelg.
Some light rain overnight in places, cool/mild condition. Wind from S-SSW around 10 knots. Water dirty close to shore in northern areas.
